correctness.rationale: For the fixed labeled twelve-vertex cubic Frucht graph, enumerate all 4096 masks and compute maximum component size in induced subgraph to classify every face of K_r. Independent computation gives the twelve cumulative face counts 169,825,1593,2281,2798,3211,3540,3827,4017,4083,4095,4096, and a fresh signed integer boundary-column reduction with exactly 2048 signed-unit pivots +/-1 reproduces all eleven positive-length bars; hence this field-universal barcode is not inferred from mod-two alone. The package source additionally implements complete Hasse-edge acyclicity of explicit Morse matchings and signed integral Morse boundary matrices with unit pivots; its cell-by-cell code and reasoning were inspected, including the r=2 three critical cells with differential (0,1), proving K2≃S3 and the stage homology/wedge assertions. r=5 is claimed only at homology level, not an unproved wedge. The integer computation is exhaustive for this one graph, not a universal family theorem.

originality.rationale: The previously published SCOPE/Resultary Frucht analysis gives only K1=Ind(F)≃∨³S² and vertex deletions/links; its full RESULT was read and it contains no r>=2 filtration, persistence, or higher-stage character. Deshpande–Singh covers general theory and named families (multipartite, whiskered, paths/cycles/trees), and Sawant covers trees, not asymmetric cyclic cubic Frucht. Stage-one is explicitly prior, while all-field barcode and higher thresholds remain new relative to inspected sources.
